entries.title: Job 13:1
segments: Lo, my eye has seen all this, my ear has heard and understood it.

entries.title: Job 13:2
segments: What you know, I know [also]; I do not fall [short] of you.

entries.title: Job 13:3
segments: Surely I would speak to the Almighty, and I desire to argue my case before God.

entries.title: Job 13:4
segments: But you [are] imputers of lies; you [are] all worthless healers.

entries.title: Job 13:5
segments: Oh that you would stop speaking entirely! And it would be your wisdom.

entries.title: Job 13:6
segments: Hear now my reasoning, and listen to the pleadings of my lips.

entries.title: Job 13:7
segments: Would you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for Him?

entries.title: Job 13:8
segments: Will you lift up His person, or contend for God?

entries.title: Job 13:9
segments: Is it good that He should search you out? Or as one man mocks another, do you mock Him?

entries.title: Job 13:10
segments: He will surely blame you, if you secretly lift up persons.

entries.title: Job 13:11
segments: Shall not His highness make you afraid, and His dread fall on you?

entries.title: Job 13:12
segments: Your remembered sayings [are] like ashes, your bodies like bodies of clay.

entries.title: Job 13:13
segments: Be quiet. Let me alone so that I may speak, and let come on me what may.

entries.title: Job 13:14
segments: Why do I take my flesh in my teeth and put my life in my hand?

entries.title: Job 13:15
segments: Though he slay me, I will not wait, but I will maintain my own ways before Him.

entries.title: Job 13:16
segments: He also [is] my salvation, for an ungodly one shall not come before Him.

entries.title: Job 13:17
segments: Listen carefully to my words, and let what I say be in your ears.

entries.title: Job 13:18
segments: Behold now, I have set [my] cause in order; I know that I shall be justified.

entries.title: Job 13:19
segments: Who [is] he [that] will plead for me, for now, I would be quiet and expire.

entries.title: Job 13:20
segments: Only do not do two [things] to me; then I will not hide myself from You.

entries.title: Job 13:21
segments: Withdraw Your hand far from me, and let not Your fear make me afraid.

entries.title: Job 13:22
segments: Then call, and I will answer; or let me speak, and answer You me.

entries.title: Job 13:23
segments: How many [are] my iniquities and sins? Make known my transgressions and my sin.

entries.title: Job 13:24
segments: Why do You hide Your face, and hold me for Your enemy?

entries.title: Job 13:25
segments: Will You terrify a leaf driven to and fro? Will You pursue the dry stubble?

entries.title: Job 13:26
segments: For You write bitter things against me, and make me to possess the sins of my youth.

entries.title: Job 13:27
segments: You put my feet also in the stocks, and look closely to all my paths; You set a limit for the soles of my feet.

entries.title: Job 13:28
segments: And he wears out like a rotten thing, like a garment that a moth eats.
